title: agentopt ledger
description: Reward memory (.agentopt/ledger.json): every change ever attempted with its outcome, so no failed idea is retried and credit stays attributed across improvement runs.

target_id.description: Manifest entry id (or playbook bullet id) the change targeted.

score_delta.description: Holdout score change in percentage points; null when discarded before full evaluation.

version.description: History version created when applied, e.g. v5.

reason.description: Why it was discarded or rolled back; read by the optimizer before proposing similar changes.

fingerprint.description: Structural fingerprint of the proposed value (target + kind + normalized content) — lets a later run skip an exact retry without re-verifying it. Null for code candidates.

decision_ref.description: Relative path (under .agentopt/reports/) to this attempt's structured decision artifact (schemas/decision.schema.json) — links the ledger to the auditable evidence the gate acted on. Null if none was written.
